versions.headline: Elon Musk Pushes Starlink for India's Remote Areas Amid Regulatory Hurdles
versions.text: Musk has accused Reliance Industries' Mukesh Ambani of blocking Starlink's entry to protect local telecom giants like Jio, while India's government insists on equal treatment for all applicants, including ongoing security reviews. In Vietnam, Starlink already provides free internet to isolated spots for tourism and disaster response, highlighting its potential for hard-to-reach areas. Yet challengers note India's cheap mobile data from Jio and Airtel covers most needs, raising questions on pricing and national security as Starlink seeks final clearances.
